observations.observation: Three independent wards: High Castle ring and cloister, Middle Castle three-sided court and Grand Masters Palace, Lower Castle Karwan and St Lawrence.
River silhouette: steep tile roofs, crenellated keep, projected Dansker and tall buttressed palace.
2006 elevated Middle Castle view: three steep-roofed ranges, center north gate tower with pointed opening and pyramidal roof, palace court projections.
Keep has paired pointed openings and blind panels, horizontal bands and open crenellations. Cloister below, steep tile roofs.
Grand Masters Palace has tall narrow buttressed window bays, pale upper clerestory, hipped tile roof and corner turrets.
High Castle courtyard hole, diagonal Dansker gallery, U-shaped Middle Castle and projecting palace match component map topology.
